name: communitydigest
author: Taako
description: Privacy-conscious scheduled community recaps with channel and forum activity, top discussions, popular links, contributor counts, previews, and automatic posting without requiring an AI provider.
install_msg: CommunityDigest loaded. Add sources with `[p]communitydigest source add`, set a destination, then preview or run it.
short: Scheduled channel and forum recaps with highlights, links, and activity summaries.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild configuration, source and destination channel IDs, scheduling timestamps, and aggregate digest run metadata. It reads recent messages when generating a digest but does not persistently store message content or author IDs.
